title: The potential of perovskite solar cell-thermoelectric tandem devices
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE00690A, Paper
Zhaoyu Lou, Jiaqi Ju, Hao Li, Zhiping Wang
This modeling study demonstrates the potential of PSC-TE systems to achieve higher PCE and steadier TD in real-world conditions, especially in specific situations, underscoring the importance of optimizing these integrated systems.
